decisive_items: Heterozygous pathogenic variant of TBK1 gene (p.E643del)
response.rationale: R2 has a definitive pathogenic TBK1 variant, which is highly specific and aligns with the cognitive, pyramidal, and bulbar features. R1 lacks genetic support and its typical PSP phenotype is contradicted by tongue atrophy and EMG findings. R3 only captures motor neuron signs without the cognitive or gaze abnormalities.

rejected.why: No genetic evidence; vertical gaze palsy and DAT loss are suggestive but tongue atrophy and EMG neurogenic changes are atypical for PSP.
Only motor neuron findings; lacks cognitive impairment, vertical gaze palsy, and genetic confirmation.
